digest.component_or_area: s3_doctor module and gitutil self-healing git seam
propositions: s3_doctor._git calls gitutil.run_git directly without retry wrapper, leaving it outside rebar's self-healing git seam unlike other store write paths
three CI runs failed identically with 'fatal: bad object HEAD' during git bundle create on merge commit, caused by object unreadable at that instant due to transient runner-FS read blip
the missing-object fault class is already handled by existing transient-retry infrastructure in other store paths but not in s3_doctor, causing disproportionate flake cost
s3_doctor route through gitutil.run_git_write inherits per-store advisory lock, index/ref-lock retry, and transient read-fault retry without adding new retry loop or backoff policy
transient test injection at git process boundary proves marker for 'bad object' signature enables heal to succeed on retry while non-transient failures remain fatal on first attempt
